Name: Festus
Summary: Festus succeeded Felix as governor and heard Paul at Caesarea. When Paul appealed to Caesar, Festus agreed, and, lacking a clear charge to send with him, brought Paul before Agrippa II to help frame the case.
KeyStory: Festus heard Paul, granted his appeal to Caesar, and asked Agrippa to help him write the charge.
LifeLesson: Festus wanted a charge to send and found none. Paul's innocence puzzled every governor who heard him.
